title: Amazon's 2026 holiday return window runs to Jan. 31, 2027
summary: Most items bought on Amazon from Nov. 1 through Dec. 31, 2026 can be returned through Jan. 31, 2027, per Amazon's return policy page. Apple-brand products have an earlier Jan. 15 deadline.
body: Amazon's return policy page lists a 2026 holiday season extended return window. Most items purchased between November 1 and December 31, 2026 can be returned through January 31, 2027.
Apple-brand products are the exception: those bought in the same window must be returned by January 15, 2027, according to the policy page.

Why it matters: the extended window lowers the risk of buying gifts early, before Black Friday crowds and stock-outs. Category rules and return fees can still apply, so check the return details on each product page.
